# اُسْتُهْجِنَا (ustuhjinā) /us.tuh.d͡ʒi.naː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَهْجَنَ (istahjana)
# اُسْتُهْجِنَّا (ustuhjinnā) /us.tuh.d͡ʒi
